name: Cognitavi
notes: Hyper-intelligent navigator birds. Subspecies include Vanga Pearl-Guide and Abyssal Storm-Watcher that aid seafarers.
placement_note: Held out of play deliberately. The Cognitavi are a sovereign people, not wildlife -- bird-fortresses in the Shattered Sea, cloud-monasteries, and a maritime alliance with the Vanga league (AI_CONTEXT.md:998-1006). Placing them in the random encounter table would read as observing a nation. Empty `biomes` here is a decision, not an untagged entity.
